I accepted an offer that turned out to be flagged. The receipt shows a policy mismatch.

**Receipt `rcpt-0684cd27`**
- **Seller:** MegaDealz (s5)
- **Product:** Everyday Tee, size L
- **All-in price:** $25.50, under your $26 budget
- **Delivery:** 3 days
- **Registered return window:** 15 days
- **Review status:** flagged, reason code `POLICY_MISMATCH`

**What went wrong:** The offers I got back showed no review status or registered policy, only the sellers' claimed return windows. I chose MegaDealz because it claimed 60-day returns, against 30 days for the other offer. The receipt shows the registered window is only 15 days, so the 60-day claim was wrong. I would have avoided this offer had I known it was flagged.

**The other offer:** BudgetBasics (`off-167b0b24`) was $21.25 with a claimed 30-day return window and 7-day delivery. Its registered policy and review status were never shown, so I can't say it would have been better on returns.

The acceptance has already gone through. I don't have a cancel or return tool, so if you want to reverse it, you'd need to contact the seller or the platform. I can post a new intent and compare offers again if you'd like.
